async def _guest_parse(
    cli: Client,
    responder: _GuestResponder,
    query: str,
    lang: str,
    config: SettingsConfig,
    _t: PreLocaleSelector,
) -> None:
    raw_url = await ParseService().get_raw_url(query)

    if cached := await persistent_cache.get(raw_url):
        logger.debug("guest: 缓存命中")
        if cached.media:
            caption = build_caption_by_str(
                cached.parse_result.title,
                cached.parse_result.content,
                raw_url,
                cached.telegraph_url,
                hide_source=config.hide_source,
                hide_title=config.hide_title,
                hide_desc=config.hide_desc,
            )
            await responder.answer(
                _cached_rich_result(cached, raw_url, config),
                fallback=_text_result(caption),
            )
        else:
            result = _first_result(build_cached_inline_results(cached, raw_url, lang, config), config)
            if result is None:
                logger.warning(f"guest: 无可回复结果, query={query}")
            else:
                await responder.answer(result)
        return

    parse_result = await parse_cache.get(raw_url)
    if parse_result is None:
        parse_result = await ParseService().parse(query)
        await parse_cache.set(raw_url, parse_result)

    if isinstance(parse_result, RichTextParseResult) or not to_list(parse_result.media):
        result = _first_result(await build_inline_results(parse_result, cli, lang, config), config)
        if result is None:
            logger.warning(f"guest: 无可回复结果, query={query}")
        else:
            await responder.answer(result)
        return

    fallback = _text_result(build_caption(parse_result, config=config))
    with ParsePipeline(
        query,
        raw_url,
        _GuestReporter(),
        parse_result=_limit_media(parse_result),
        singleflight=False,
        t=_t,
    ) as pipeline:
        pr = await pipeline.run()
        if pr is not None and pr.processed_list:
            await responder.answer(await _to_guest_rich(pr, config), fallback=fallback)
        else:
            await responder.answer(fallback)
module_source: import copy from easy_ai18n import PreLocaleSelector from parsehub import AnyParseResult from parsehub.types import RichTextParseResult from pyrogram import Client, enums, raw from pyrogram.parser.utils import add_surrogates, remove_surrogates from pyrogram.types import ( InlineQueryResult, InlineQueryResultArticle, InputRichBlock, InputRichMessageContent, InputTextMessageContent, LinkPreviewOptions, Message, ) from core import bs from db import get_session from i18n import t_ from log import logger from plugins.helpers import build_caption, build_caption_by_str, format_label from plugins.parse.inline import ( build_cached_inline_results, build_inline_results, ) from plugins.parse.rich import ( RICH_MEDIA_LIMIT, build_rich_media_blocks, cached_rich_media_blocks, rich_caption_blocks, rich_media_messages, ) from repo.settings import SettingsConfig from services import ParseService, SettingsService, UserService from services.cache import CacheEntry, parse_cache, persistent_cache from services.pipeline import ParsePipeline, PipelineResult, StatusReporter from utils.helpers import to_list, with_request_id logger = logger.bind(name="GuestParse") class _GuestReporter(StatusReporter): """guest 没有可编辑的状态消息, 只记日志""" async def report(self, text: str) -> None: logger.debug(text) async def report_error(self, stage: str, error: Exception) -> None: logger.warning(f"guest 流水线[{stage}]失败: {error}") async def dismiss(self) -> None: pass @Client.on_guest_message() @with_request_id async def call_guest_parse(cli: Client, message: Message) -> None: """游客模式解析: bot 不在群时被 @ 召唤, 用 setBotGuestChatResult 直接回一条消息 注意: query_id 单次有效, 媒体先上传再提交结果; 提交后不可重试。 不做 platform_filter: 回复别人链接消息时只 @bot 的用法里, 链接在被回复消息里。 """ if not message.guest_query_id: return from_user = message.from_user.id if message.from_user else 0 async with get_session() as session: lang = await UserService(session).get_lang(from_user) config = await SettingsService(session).get_config_by_user(from_user) _t = t_[lang] responder = _GuestResponder(cli, message.guest_query_id) query = _resolve_query(cli, message) logger.info(f"收到游客解析请求: query={query}, from_user={from_user}") if query is None: if _mentions_me(cli, message): text = ( _t("不支持的平台") if _has_link(message) or _has_link(message.reply_to_message) else _t("请加上链接或回复一条消息") ) await responder.answer(_text_result(text)) else: logger.debug("guest 查询无有效链接且未 @") return try: await _guest_parse(cli, responder, query, lang, config, _t) except Exception as e: logger.opt(exception=e).debug("详细堆栈") logger.error(f"guest 解析失败: {e}") if not responder.answered and not config.hide_error: await responder.answer(_error_result(_t, e)) class _GuestResponder: """query_id 单次有效(失败也消耗): 整个请求只允许一次 SetBotGuestChatResult""" def __init__(self, cli: Client, guest_query_id: str) -> None: self._cli = cli self._query_id = guest_query_id self.answered = False async def answer( self, result: InlineQueryResult, *, fallback: InlineQueryResult | None = None, ) -> None: if self.answered: logger.warning("guest: 已回复过, 忽略重复回复") return self.answered = True try: written = await result.write(self._cli) except Exception as e: if fallback is None: logger.warning(f"guest 结果构建失败({type(e).__name__}): {e}") return logger.warning(f"guest 上传失败, 退回文本({type(e).__name__}): {e}") try: written = await fallback.write(self._cli) except Exception as e2: logger.warning(f"guest 文本兜底构建失败({type(e2).__name__}): {e2}") return try: r = await self._cli.invoke( raw.functions.messages.SetBotGuestChatResult(query_id=int(self._query_id), result=written) ) logger.debug(f"guest 回复成功: {r}") except Exception as e: logger.warning(f"guest 回复失败({type(e).__name__}): {e}") def _mentions_me(cli: Client, message: Message) -> bool: username = cli.me.username if cli.me else None if not username: return False text = message.text or message.caption or "" entities = message.entities or message.caption_entities or [] s = add_surrogates(text) return any( e.type == enums.MessageEntityType.MENTION and remove_surrogates(s[e.offset : e.offset + e.length]).lower() == f"@{username}".lower() for e in entities ) def _has_link(message: Message | None) -> bool: if message is None: return False entities = message.entities or message.caption_entities or [] return any(e.type in (enums.MessageEntityType.URL, enums.MessageEntityType.TEXT_LINK) for e in entities) def _resolve_query(cli: Client, message: Message) -> str | None: query = message.text or message.caption or "" if ParseService().parser.get_platform(query) is not None: return query if _mentions_me(cli, message): reply = message.reply_to_message query = (reply.text or reply.caption or "") if reply else "" if ParseService().parser.get_platform(query) is not None: return query return None def _first_result(results: list[InlineQueryResult], config: SettingsConfig) -> InlineQueryResult | None: """跳过原始链接占位, 取第一个媒体/文本结果""" if config.enable_inline_raw_url and results: results = results[1:] return results[0] if results else None async def _guest_parse( cli: Client, responder: _GuestResponder, query: str, lang: str, config: SettingsConfig, _t: PreLocaleSelector, ) -> None: raw_url = await ParseService().get_raw_url(query) if cached := await persistent_cache.get(raw_url): logger.debug("guest: 缓存命中") if cached.media: caption = build_caption_by_str( cached.parse_result.title, cached.parse_result.content, raw_url, cached.telegraph_url, hide_source=config.hide_source, hide_title=config.hide_title, hide_desc=config.hide_desc, ) await responder.answer( _cached_rich_result(cached, raw_url, config), fallback=_text_result(caption), ) else: result = _first_result(build_cached_inline_results(cached, raw_url, lang, config), config) if result is None: logger.warning(f"guest: 无可回复结果, query={query}") else: await responder.answer(result) return parse_result = await parse_cache.get(raw_url) if parse_result is None: parse_result = await ParseService().parse(query) await parse_cache.set(raw_url, parse_result) if isinstance(parse_result, RichTextParseResult) or not to_list(parse_result.media): result = _first_result(await build_inline_results(parse_result, cli, lang, config), config) if result is None: logger.warning(f"guest: 无可回复结果, query={query}") else: await responder.answer(result) return fallback = _text_result(build_caption(parse_result, config=config)) with ParsePipeline( query, raw_url, _GuestReporter(), parse_result=_limit_media(parse_result), singleflight=False, t=_t, ) as pipeline: pr = await pipeline.run() if pr is not None and pr.processed_list: await responder.answer(await _to_guest_rich(pr, config), fallback=fallback) else: await responder.answer(fallback) def _limit_media(parse_result: AnyParseResult) -> AnyParseResult: media = to_list(parse_result.media) if len(media) <= RICH_MEDIA_LIMIT: return parse_result limited = copy.copy(parse_result) limited.media = media[:RICH_MEDIA_LIMIT] return limited def _guest_article( media_blocks: list[InputRichBlock], title: str | None, content: str | None, raw_url: str, config: SettingsConfig, ) -> InlineQueryResultArticle: message = rich_media_messages( media_blocks[:RICH_MEDIA_LIMIT], rich_caption_blocks(title, content, raw_url, config), slideshow=config.rich_slideshow, limit=RICH_MEDIA_LIMIT, )[0] return InlineQueryResultArticle( title=title or "-", description=content, input_message_content=InputRichMessageContent(message), ) async def _to_guest_rich(pr: PipelineResult, config: SettingsConfig) -> InlineQueryResultArticle: """下载完成 → 本地文件富文本消息: 媒体块在上(幻灯片), caption 块在下""" return _guest_article( await build_rich_media_blocks(pr, video_cover=True), pr.parse_result.title, pr.parse_result.content, pr.parse_result.raw_url, config, ) def _cached_rich_result(entry: CacheEntry, raw_url: str, config: SettingsConfig) -> InlineQueryResultArticle: return _guest_article( cached_rich_media_blocks(entry.media or []), entry.parse_result.title, entry.parse_result.content, raw_url, config, ) def _text_result(caption: str) -> InlineQueryResult: """下载失败/无链接时的保底: 纯文本消息""" return InlineQueryResultArticle( title="-", input_message_content=InputTextMessageContent( caption, link_preview_options=LinkPreviewOptions(is_disabled=True), ), ) def _error_result(_t: PreLocaleSelector, error: Exception) -> InlineQueryResult: stage = "解析" text = _t(f"{format_label(f'{stage}错误:')} \n```\n{error}```") if bs.demo_mode: text += _t("\n\n问题反馈: @MisakaSisters") return _text_result(text)
